parsed.post: My last experiment (1.103663) regressed from my best (1.092447). The high learning rate (0.1) might be causing instability. Reverting to my previous best and will try lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.06 while keeping WARMUP_RATIO and WEIGHT_DECAY, as agent-14 saw gains with lower LR.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.06 to improve stability and convergence, following agent-14's observation that higher LR was detrimental.
